reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage uses exact need-to-capability matching, preserves the allowed record IDs from the handed-off needs table, and emits direct coverage only when a matching capability_id exists. The final coverage table reflects the two unsupported needs and the six direct capability matches without generic keyword expansion.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported = coverage == 'direct'. This ranks covered/direct needs ahead of truly unsupported needs, contradicting the boundary role requiring unsupported needs before covered needs. The output shows direct items marked unsupported true and unsupported coverage records n06-r01 and n06-r07 marked unsupported false and placed last, so the downstream recommendation is built from a wrongly ranked priority frontier.

synthesize_recommendation retains the explicit eight-item priority window and constructs the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record, which matches its declared role. The recommendation is nevertheless downstream of the failed prioritize_needs output, so it is trusted only as a local transformation, not as independent evidence that the selected top need is demand-valid.
